LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public leaderboard profile and personal best score for a player (contains no PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player chosen display name shown on the leaderboard.

highScore.description: Highest score achieved by the player.

bestDistance.description: Furthest distance in meters achieved by the player.

correctAnswers.description: Correct answers in the best run.

isAnonymous.description: Whether the player signed in anonymously as guest.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Stores each player's display name and highest score for the realtime Top 10 leaderboard.
